consequence.statement: Repositories configured in argocd-cm ConfigMap will no longer be honored in Argo CD 3.0, as this legacy configuration method has been removed.
consequence.remediation: Migrate repositories from argocd-cm ConfigMap to repository Secrets following the declarative management documentation.

assertion.statement: The argocd-cm ConfigMap keys for repositories (repositories, repository.credentials, helm.repositories) have been removed and are no longer supported in Argo CD 3.0.
